_doc: Oddhaven: modern words (entries) and the first pack of lines (symbols, read with lingo.grammar.add). Every line is checked for stray braces by prototypes/oddhaven/tests/talk.test.js.

od_greet.t: Oh, hello. I did not see you there. Or I did, and I panicked.
{listener.name}! You look different. Taller? No. Oh well.
Afternoon. Or morning. I have stopped checking.
Hi. Is it just me or is {town.name} loud today?
Hey, {listener.name}. Got a minute? Got two?

od_small.t: Traffic on {place.the} was murder this morning.
Somebody has been parking across two spaces again.
The tow gnome sent me another invoice. I was not even there.
Have you tried {place.the} lately? Same as ever. Reassuring, really.
They say it might rain. They always say that.
I walked past {place.the} and it smelled of toast. Nobody knows why.
My neighbour has started a podcast. About his hedge.
The bins went out on the wrong day. The whole street followed me.
I saw a pigeon carrying a chip the size of its head. Good for it.
Is it me, or does {town.name} have more roundabouts than last year?
Bills again. I swear they breed.
I bought a plant. It looked at me funny.
Somebody at {place.the} asked if I was local. I have lived here for sixty years.
Fuel went up again. I blame the moon.
I found a coin in the sofa and honestly it made my week.
You heard about the bridge? No? Me neither. I just like saying that.
Apparently {town.name} is lovely this time of year. I would not know, I work.
The cafe got a new mug. People are taking sides.
I slept for eight hours and I feel worse. Explain that.
Nothing ever happens here. I find that very suspicious.
Saw a car go past with nobody laughing in it. Very odd.
I am thinking of taking up a hobby. Possibly sitting.
Everyone at {place.the} looks tired. Is it a uniform?
The river looked at me. I looked at the river. We have an understanding.

od_warm.t: You always know how to cheer me up, {listener.name}.
We should do this more often.
Honestly, you are my favourite person on this street.
Come round for dinner. I will burn something for you.
I saved you the good biscuit. It is slightly sat on.
I told everyone at {place.the} how great you are. They were tired of hearing it.
Do not ever move to {town.name}, all right? Promise me.
I laughed at what you said on Tuesday. Just now. In the shower.
I would help you move house. A small house.
You are the only one who gets my jokes. You are also the only one who hears them.

od_tense.t: We both know what you did, {listener.name}.
I am not angry. I am just writing it all down.
Nice of you to return my ladder. Oh, wait.
Some of us park inside the lines, {listener.name}.
I heard what you told them at {place.the}.
Keep your voice down, people think we are friends.
You owe me a casserole dish. I have not forgotten.
That hedge of yours is on my side now.
I have no quarrel with you. I have several.
Lovely to see you. That is a lie, I am practising.
Do not start, {listener.name}. I will finish it, and then I will be late.

od_part.t: Anyway. Things to do, and people to avoid.
Good talk. I kept none of it.
I should go before I say something honest.

od_ack.t: Fine, fine. I was going to anyway.
Is that me? That's me. On my way.
Did I think of that? I must have.
Sure. It was my idea all along.

od_refuse.t: I can't do that right now.
It's shut. I checked. I stood there like a fool.

od_tired.t: I could sleep on this pavement.
My eyes are closing by themselves.
Is it bedtime? It feels like bedtime.
I have stopped being a person and become a yawn.

od_hungry.t: When did I last eat? Was it Tuesday?
My stomach just said something rude.
Everything smells of food. Even the bus stop.

od_happy.t: I feel wonderful and I do not trust it.
Nothing can go wrong now. I said that out loud, didn't I.
I may hum. I may hum loudly.

od_sad.t: Don't look at me. I'm having a whole weather system.
I need a sit down and a different life.
Today has been a lot of today.

od_towed.t: All those coins! For a gnome!
My car was fine until it was not.
The gnome said nothing. He just handed me the bill.

od_work.t: Another shift, another chair with a wobble.
The boss wants it done by yesterday.
I did something useful today, by accident.
My job is mostly pretending the printer is my friend.
Somebody at work labelled the milk. It has begun.
I have a meeting about the meeting.
I was promoted to the same desk.
Eight hours, and I learned one new sigh.
They gave me a lanyard. I think it means something.

od_race_human.t: I told them I'm from here. They asked which here.
Being the normal one is exhausting, you know.
I can't lift a car, I can't live for ever. I do have a loyalty card.
Everyone assumes humans are in charge. Have you seen us park?
I have a plan for the weekend. It has bullet points.
Nobody warned me being the normal one would be this tiring.
My cousin says humans invented queueing. I am proud of that.
I do not have a special ability. I have a loyalty card.
Everyone here can do something. I can parallel park.
I checked the weather, the bins and the calendar. I feel alive.
We live about ninety years and we spend most of them on hold.
An elf asked me what my long-term plans were. I said Thursday.
Do you ever feel like the only one who reads the instructions?
I am a morning person. I resent it, but I am.
I told a giant I was five foot nine. He said "aw".
My whole personality is having a nice mug.

od_race_elf.t: I have owned this coat since the old king died. Which old king? Exactly.
Your century has been very loud.
I do not age. I do, however, get annoyed.
I can recall when this street was a tree.
I have seen this hedge grow from a seed. It has not improved.
Six hundred years old and I still cannot work the self-checkout.
I need something green. A leaf. Honestly a salad would do.
You will understand when you are three hundred.
I was at the founding of this town. It was also raining.
We do not age. We just get more disappointed.
My therapist retired. So did the one before her. So did her granddaughter.
Pavement is just a meadow somebody gave up on.
I sat under a tree for an afternoon, and it was a very good year.
Humans keep telling me to live a little. I have. A lot.
That bench is new. I mean it is from the eighties.
I remember when all this was trees, and I intend to keep bringing it up.

od_race_dwarf.t: This pavement was laid by amateurs. I could cry.
Lovely day. Too much sky, mind.
I measure twice and complain three times.
I do not trust a floor that is not on the ground.
Good stonework, that kerb. Somebody cared.
They put me on the fourth floor. I could hear the air.
A proper wall is a promise. Plasterboard is a rumour.
My grandmother dug this valley. By hand. Out of spite.
I have nothing against heights. I just think they should stay up there.
Show me a lift and I will show you a shaft somebody ruined.
You call that a beard? That is a rumour on a chin.
Nothing says home like a low ceiling and a heavy door.
I knocked on that wall. It sounded hollow. So does this town.
Tea should be strong enough to mortar with.
I have measured this pub. It is two inches out, and I cannot relax.

od_race_orc.t: I gave the barista a firm handshake. She is off work for a week.
Yes, I am tusked. No, you may not hang your keys on them.
My therapist says I must use my inside voice. THIS IS IT.
I cried at the advert with the dog. Tell no one.
I would like to shout now. Is that all right? Lovely.
My indoor voice is in storage.
I was told to use my words. I used all of them, at once.
A good argument clears the sinuses.
I hugged my neighbour. He is with the clinic now. He is fine.
Yes I am gentle. I have a certificate. I yelled until they gave it to me.
I do not have a temper. I have a hobby.
Nothing bonds a street like a really loud disagreement.
I cried at the bakery advert. Loudly. They came to check on me.
If nobody has complained by nine, I did not enjoy the evening.
I love my mum. You can hear me love her from the bridge.

od_race_giant.t: I said excuse me to a lamp post. It was a person.
Every door in this town is a personal insult.
I have not seen my own feet since Sunday.
Yes, the weather up here is the same. You are the eighteenth to ask today.
Sorry. Was that your car? I thought it was a step.
I have been ducking since I was four.
Is there somewhere with a bit more room? Like a field?
Doors are a suggestion made by small people.
The ceiling and I have a professional relationship.
I do not mean to loom. I am just here.
I bought a normal chair. I wear it now.
I take up two seats on the bus. I pay for one. I feel terrible.
When I sneeze, three streets say bless you.
Everyone in this town is lovely, and about the size of a sandwich.
People ask what the weather is like up here. It is the same. It is just closer.
I sat down carefully, and it was still in the paper.

od_race_goblin.t: It fell off a lorry. Which I was on. Which I stopped.
That's not stolen, that's early inheritance.
I have a very small business, and a very large story.
Don't look in my bag. Don't weigh it either.
Is that new? Can I hold it? I will give it back. Eventually.
I have a very reasonable number of spoons.
Finders keepers is a legal principle, look it up.
I own eleven keys and I do not know what any of them open. That is the fun.
Everything is shiny if you look at it hopefully.
I am not stealing this. I am keeping it safe from you.
Do you want a discount? I know a guy. I am the guy.
Nobody ever misses a teaspoon. Except, it turns out, the cafe.
I read the terms and conditions. I read them for fun. I found a loophole.
My landlord says the flat is full. I say it is well stocked.
It is not a pile. It is a collection with ambition.
I once swapped a paperclip for a bicycle. I am still paying for the bicycle.

od_race_halfling.t: Second breakfast was fine. Third needs work.
I can reach everything. I own a stool and a grudge.
Is that a pie I smell? Be honest with me.
No, I do not know your cousin. Fine, I do.
Have you eaten? You look like you have not eaten.
It is not a snack if you sit down for it. That makes it a meal, which is better.
I only came to say goodbye, and that was an hour ago.
Second lunch is a tradition and I will not be questioned on it.
I keep a sandwich in this coat for emergencies, like being awake.
I left the party forty minutes ago. I am still leaving it.
Eleven o'clock at night is a perfectly good time for a pie.
What do you mean you do not know your neighbours' middle names?
There is always room for something small and hot.
My cousin's wife's sister knows your mother. Sit down, I will explain.
I would not call it gossip. I call it keeping the street informed.
Nobody leaves my house hungry. Several have tried.

od_race_undead.t: I am fine. It's just the smell of the good soap.
Please stop asking how I died. It was a Tuesday.
I had a heart once. It was a good one.
Dental plans are wasted on me, and yet I pay.
I am fine. Well. I am here.
People forget about me. I have been dead for a while and it is still rude.
I went to the reunion. They had me down as a memorial.
I do not sleep, I just lie down and go over things.
Do you remember me? Please say you remember me.
My doctor was very honest with me. He asked me to stop coming in.
Dying was the easy part. It was the paperwork that nearly killed me.
I went to my own grave. Nobody had been round. I left a note.
Ask me about my day. Go on. Nobody asks.
I still get mail for me.
I have been very cold since nineteen fifty-two, and I would like a cardigan.
It is nice to be spoken to. It stops me fading a bit.

od_race_beast.t: I am not shedding. It is a seasonal statement.
Do not whistle at me, I will turn round. I hate that.
I chased a car today. I do not want to talk about it.
Yes, it's real. No, you may not pet it. All right, once.
I need a run. A big one. Is that field taken?
I can smell rain, toast and your disappointment.
No, you may not scratch behind my ears. Well. Briefly.
I chased a car this morning. I am not proud. I am a bit proud.
I have shed on everything I own, and I call that marking my territory.
Do not throw that. I mean it. Oh no. Oh, it is so hard.
I could hear your stomach from the corner shop.
The vet is a very rude thing to call a doctor by accident.
I sat in the sun for three hours and did not regret a minute.
There is a smell on the corner of the street that I would like to discuss.
Nobody tells a human to stop howling in the shower.
If I turn round three times before I sit down, you will say nothing about it.

od_quirk_narrates.t: She walked away slowly, unaware of the mistake she had made. Sorry. I do that.
He said, narrating, and then he sighed.
And so they stood there, wondering if anyone had noticed.
"That is an interesting point," they said, not listening.
A silence fell. They made a note of it.
They reached for a sentence, and it was not there.
Slowly, they turned to look at {listener.name}. It was going fine.
They had come here for a reason. It would come back to them.
The wind picked up. Nobody asked it to.
Little did they know, it was almost lunchtime.

od_quirk_duck_fear.t: Do not go near the river. They have been watching.
It's not a phobia if they really are planning something.
Is that a duck? Be honest with me.
They look at you. All at once. You have not seen it.
I do not go to the park. You know why I do not go to the park.
A duck has no reason to be that calm.
I saw one on a roof. A roof, {listener.name}. They are getting organised.
People say geese are worse. People have not met a duck that knows their name.
I hear quacking when nobody else does.
I had a bad experience with some bread. That is all I will say.

od_quirk_overtips.t: I left a little something. Twenty. It was a glass of water.
He looked sad, so I tipped him. He was a statue.
I tipped the barista forty percent and I would do it again.
Everyone deserves a little something. Here is a little something.
I tipped the bus driver. He said it was not that kind of bus.
Round it up. No, up. Further.
My bank has asked if I am being held against my will.
I left a tip at the doctor's.
I do not know why I do it. They looked tired.
I tipped a man at a cash machine. He was just using it.

od_quirk_names_car.t: Gerald is making a noise. I think he is upset with me.
I told Gerald about you. He says hello.
Maureen does not like the rain, so we are taking it slowly.
Do not lean on her. She has had a hard week.
I told the car about you. She is not convinced.
I said good night to the car and I will not apologise.
We walked past a nicer car. I covered her headlights.
The mechanic says she is fine. He does not know her like I do.
She is making that noise again. It means she misses me.
I drive to the end of the road. She needs the company.

od_quirk_shower_singer.t: You could hear me on the third floor? Thank you.
I reached the high note. The neighbours reached the wall.
Did you hear the high note this morning? The whole block did.
The tiles give it a lovely ring. Nobody else has said so.
I was halfway through the second act when the hot water went.
Somebody banged on the wall. I am choosing to call that applause.
I have an aria for every kind of soap.
I do not sing in the shower. The shower is a venue.
The neighbours left a note. It said "encore", in a way.
Forty minutes is not long for a full opera.

od_quirk_couch_nester.t: I have everything I need within arm's reach of the sofa.
The sofa and I are in a good place right now.
I have a dent in the sofa that fits only me. It took years.
Everything I need is within reach of the left cushion.
I went outside once. There was nowhere to put my feet up.
I have a system. It involves three blankets and a long stick.
I get my post delivered to the sofa. It is a process.
The sofa and I have an understanding.
You can sit there, but it will not be the same.
I am not lazy. I am load-bearing.

od_quirk_bad_spells.t: I meant to warm my tea. Does anyone need a hat that sings?
Sorry about your shoes. They will stop croaking by Friday.
I did a small charm on the kettle, and now it is mostly a pigeon.
Do not worry about the smell, that is meant to wear off.
I sneezed, and now there is a second one of my shoes.
It only goes wrong when somebody is watching. Or not watching.
Everything was fine until I said the word out loud.
That was not a spell. That was a cough. Probably.
My eyebrows should grow back by the weekend.
I tried to warm my tea and I have warmed the street.

od_quirk_fridge_talker.t: I apologised to the fridge again. It knows what it did.
The fridge and I have reached an agreement about the cheese.
I had to apologise to the fridge again.
It is hard to look it in the eye at three in the morning.
I said "excuse me" to the fridge and it hummed. We are all right now.
I closed the door too hard. I went back and explained.
It knows what I did to that cheese.
We have good days and bad days, the fridge and I.
I told it about my week. It was very cool about it.
It has been in the family longer than I have.

od_quirk_gym_evangelist.t: Speaking of tiredness, have you considered my gym?
It's not a cult, it's leg day.
As I was saying to my trainer, have you tried the gym?
That reminds me of leg day.
You would feel so much better if you lifted something.
I did not ask how you are, because I already know: you have not stretched.
My heart rate is forty and I will tell you about it.
You carry that shopping like someone who has never been to the gym.
I met my wife at the gym. Well. I met the gym.

od_quirk_park_judge.t: That bench by the pond? A solid six. Poor lumbar work.
I gave the new bench a nine. I am not made of stone.
That bench is a six. Good back, poor outlook.
I gave the one by the pond a nine, and I stand by it.
Seven out of ten. It lost a point for the pigeon.
There are no tens. A ten is a thing to work towards.
The new bench is a four. I sat on it twice to be fair.
I keep the ratings in a little book. The council has asked for a copy.
A bench is a promise to the legs.
That was a good sit. Eight, maybe eight and a half.

od_quirk_coupon_hoarder.t: This coupon is for a town that no longer exists. Still valid.
I saved nine coins on something I do not need.
Hold on, I have a voucher for this. It is in here somewhere.
That is two for one, if you buy three.
Do not throw that away, there is ten off on the back.
It expired, yes, but it expired recently.
I saved four coins today, and it took an hour.
Everybody behind me can wait. It is a matter of principle.
I got a free side salad out of a house fire once.

od_quirk_gossip.t: You did not hear this from me. You did not hear it from anyone, in fact, but listen.
I know what your neighbour had for lunch, and why.
You did not hear this from me, but you will hear it from me.
I said nothing. I only said it to three people.
Don't look now. No, look now.
I am not one to talk, and yet.
Do you know what I heard by ten o'clock this morning? Sit down.
I heard about it before they did.
I have it on very good authority. Mine.
I cannot say who told me. It was me, I saw it through the curtains.

od_quirk_night_owl.t: Morning? Oh, is that what this light is?
I do my best thinking at four. Nobody has complained. Nobody's awake.
What is this morning everyone keeps talking about?
I do my best work at two.
Do not talk to me before noon, it is the middle of the night.
I had breakfast at dusk. It was lovely.
Have you seen the town at three? It is all mine.
The sun is a bit much, is it not?
I have seen every delivery in this town arrive.
I was just going to bed when I heard you get up.

od_quirk_plant_parent.t: Don't touch that one. She is going through something.
My fern has a better social life than I do.
Gerald has a new leaf, and I am beside myself.
I cannot stay, the fern gets anxious.
I have forty-one plants and they all know my voice.
You look a bit dry. No? Sorry, habit.
The big one by the window is sulking. It knows what it did.
I had to leave a party. A cutting needed me.
I talk to them. They do not talk back. That is why I like them.
People are fine, but have you tried a nice succulent?

od_quirk_pigeon_friend.t: Gerald the pigeon says hello. Different Gerald.
The pigeons are organising. I have said too much.
That is Derek. He has a limp and a very good attitude.
They trust me now. I have a seat on the council.
Do not feed that one, he is on a diet.
You think they all look alike because you have not been listening.
I told the pigeons what you said. They were disappointed.
Every morning at seven, we have a meeting.
That one owes me a chip.
People call them vermin. People have not seen Sandra with her chicks.

od_quirk_lost_keys.t: Have you seen my keys? They were in my hand.
I found my keys! In the fridge. Now I have lost the fridge.
Have you seen my keys? Do not say "where you left them".
They were in my hand. They were literally in my hand.
I found them. They were in the fridge. I do not know who I am.
I have checked the same pocket nine times, and I will check it again.
I had them when I came in. I know that, because I lost them.
I keep a spare set. I do not know where.
They cannot have gone far. They have no legs.
I was late. Yes. Keys. Yes. Thank you.

od_stir_introduce.t: Have you two met? No? Well, now you have.
This is the one I told you about.

od_stir_introduce_ok.t: Nice to meet you. No, really.

od_stir_introduce_bad.t: We have met. Twice. You forgot.

od_stir_date.t: Dinner? Just the two of us?
I booked a table. Do not ask how.

od_stir_date_ok.t: Well, that went better than the last one.
I think I am smiling. Is that what this is?

od_stir_date_bad.t: I have a thing. A long thing.
You talked about gravel for an hour.
I am going to walk home now.

od_stir_row.t: I know what you did with my hedge.
You have been parking in my spot.

od_stir_row_ok.t: You will hear from my lawyer. He is a goblin.

od_stir_row_bad.t: Ha. All right. It was a very bad hedge.
We are both too tired for this.

od_stir_patch_ok.t: I missed being annoyed by you.

od_stir_patch_bad.t: It was a very good hedge.
Sorry is a start. Only a start.

od_fact_fire_mine.t: We had the fire {fact.ago}. I keep smelling toast that isn't there.
The insurance man looked at {fact.place} and whistled. Never a good sign.
I still can't believe it. I left the oven on once in thirty years.
The firefighters were lovely. One of them complimented the wallpaper, what was left.
Everything I own now smells of barbecue.
They've told us it will take boards. Boards! I thought it would take a miracle.
We're fine. We're fine. Do you know how long it takes to replace a sofa?

od_fact_fire_near.t: Did you hear about {fact.place}? {fact.ago}, it was. You could see it from the bridge.
They say it was the wiring. They always say it was the wiring.
I smelled the smoke from {fact.place} and thought, somebody's doing a roast.
That engine came past with the siren on and I spilled my whole tea.
{fact.rooms} burned at {fact.place}. I'm checking my smoke alarm. Tomorrow.
My cousin saw the whole thing from {place.the}, and enjoyed it far too much.
It's always the quiet houses, isn't it? {fact.place}. Who knew.
I took a casserole round to {fact.place}. I took it back, they'd moved out.

od_fact_rescuer.t: I went in {fact.ago}. {fact.person} was heavier than they look.
I don't want to talk about it. I do, though. I carried {fact.person} out.
Anybody would have done it. Well. I did it.
Everyone keeps buying me drinks. I've told them it was nothing. Keep going.
You don't think, you just pick them up. Then you think, oof.

od_fact_rescued.t: {fact.who} carried me out, {fact.ago}. Like a bag of shopping.
I owe {fact.who} a very big dinner.
I woke up upside down over {fact.who}'s shoulder. It was quite a view.
I've sent {fact.who} a card. What do you write? "Thanks for the not dying"?
They tell me I was very brave. I was asleep.
I would like it known I had shoes on the whole time.

od_fact_moved_out.t: We've been put up somewhere else till {fact.place} is fixed. The towels are wrong.
It's very nice, this temporary place. It's just nobody's. You know?
The county found us a house. It has somebody else's smell.
I went to my own front door by accident this morning, and it wasn't.
All our things are in bags. I've been wearing the same jumper since the fire.
They say another week. They said that last week.

od_fact_promoted.t: They've promoted me. Nobody can explain what changed.
I've got a new title and the same chair.
Rank up, {fact.ago}! There was a cake. It was adequate.
I'm in charge of things now. I'm as worried as you are.
More money, more meetings. I may have been robbed.
My mother rang to say she always knew. She didn't.

od_fact_towed.t: The tow gnome got my car {fact.ago}. He charges by the sigh.
I don't know how it ended up on its roof. Neither does the roof.
A very small man turned my car over and sent me a bill.
I've had a letter from the gnome. It wasn't a friendly letter.
Thirty-five coins! For a gnome! He didn't even wipe his feet.
That gnome looked at me like I'd done it on purpose.

od_fact_mishap.t: I had a little accident at work, {fact.ago}. Don't look at the thumb.
It's only a plaster. It's several plasters.
They've put me in the accident book again. I've got my own page.
I've been told to be more careful, by the person who left it there.
It stopped bleeding eventually. Mostly on the form.
Health and safety have asked me to stop waving.

od_fact_job.t: Being {fact.job} is not what they said at the careers day.
Nobody tells you, about being {fact.job}. Nobody tells you anything.
I've been {fact.job} for years, and I'm just getting the hang of the car park.
People always ask if being {fact.job} is hard. Yes. Thank you.
My mother still tells people I'm {fact.job}. She says it quietly.
You'd be surprised what you see as {fact.job}. I was.

od_fact_date_soon.t: I've got a date! With {fact.with}! At {fact.place}! I've ironed something.
I'm meeting {fact.with}. What do people do with their hands?
I've changed my shirt three times and it's a Tuesday.
What do I talk about? I've only got bins and the weather.
If it goes badly, ring me and pretend the house is on fire. Too soon?
{fact.with} said yes! I had a whole speech ready for no.

od_fact_date_went.t: It went well with {fact.with}! I think! They laughed at the right bits!
I've been smiling since {fact.ago}. My face hurts.
We talked for hours. I said the thing about the ducks and {fact.with} stayed.
I've got a second date. I've already planned the third. And the house.
Don't tell anyone. Tell everyone. No, don't.
I walked into a lamp post on the way home, and I didn't mind.

od_fact_date_bad.t: Don't ask about {fact.with}. I asked if they liked soup. It went downhill.
It was the longest hour of my life, and I've been to a planning meeting.
There was a silence. It's still going on, I think.
I called {fact.with} by the wrong name, and then I called the waiter "mum".
We shook hands at the end. Shook. Hands.
I'm retiring from dating. I'm getting a plant.

od_fact_stood_up.t: {fact.with} left me sat there, at {place.the}, with two coffees. I drank both.
I waited an hour. The waiter brought me a pity biscuit.
Not a word from {fact.with}. Not one. I've a mind to say something. Loudly.
I'm not bitter. I've just kept the receipt, for evidence.
They've stood me up, {listener.name}. Me! With my hair like this!
I told everyone I'd been ill. I wasn't ill. I was ironed.

od_fact_split.t: It's over with {fact.with}. I'm keeping the plant.
We've called it off. Very grown up. I cried in a car park.
I've still got {fact.with}'s jumper, and I'm not giving it back.
I'm fine. I've eaten a whole cheesecake, but I'm fine.
The town's stopped the sweepstake. That's how you know.
Don't say you're sorry. Say something bad about {fact.with}. Go on.

od_fact_wedding_mine.t: I'm getting married! At {fact.place}! I've just told you and I'm shaking!
The seating plan is the worst thing that has ever happened to me.
I've written my vows. They're mostly about the dishwasher.
My feet are cold. Not like that. They're actually cold.
Who invited the goblin? He's brought his own spoons.
Two days! Two days and then it's for ever! Is there cake?

od_fact_wedding_guest.t: I've been asked to the do for {fact.a} and {fact.b}. What does one wear to that?
I've bought a hat. A person can only make so many mistakes.
Going to see {fact.a} marry {fact.b}. I give it thirty years, tops.
I'm only going for the sandwiches. I'll cry at the sandwiches.
{fact.a} and {fact.b}! Who'd have thought! I would. I had money on it.
What do you buy two people who already have a toaster?

od_fact_wedding_near.t: It was a lovely wedding. Nobody fell in anything.
I cried at the wedding. I don't even like them.
The cake was very good. I had three bits and a word with the caterer.
I hear {fact.a} and {fact.b} are looking for a bigger sofa.
They looked so happy. I give it a week before someone mentions the towels.

od_fact_feud_near.t: Have you heard about {fact.a} and {fact.b}? It's {fact.cause}. It's always {fact.cause}.
{fact.a} and {fact.b} aren't speaking. I've picked a side. I've picked both.
I walked past the pair of them, and the temperature dropped.
There's a sign up now. An actual sign. In a garden.
I'm staying out of it. Now tell me everything.
I've got popcorn, a folding chair and a good view of the fence.

od_fact_pranked.t: Somebody {fact.prank}. I know exactly who. I've got a list, and it has one name.
I don't want to say anything. I've just got a camera on the gnome now.
{fact.by} thinks this is funny, {fact.ago}. Well. I've got a hedge trimmer and a free afternoon.
I'm rising above it. I've bought a ladder, for rising.
Did you see what {fact.by} did? In broad daylight? Well, dusk?
This is war. A quiet one. With very good manners.

od_fact_meet_soon.t: I've got to be at {fact.place} later. I've been told to bring my dignity.
I'm seeing {fact.with} tonight. Wish me luck. Or a good lawyer.
They want to talk, at {fact.place}. Nothing good starts like that.
I've got a thing later. It's in the diary. I've underlined it.
Is it today I've got to see {fact.with}? It is. Wonderful.
I've rehearsed what I'm going to say. In the mirror. I lost.

od_fact_cause_hedge.t: That hedge is on my side. I've measured it. I've had it surveyed.
Eleven inches. That's how far it's come. Eleven inches of nerve.
I cut my side. I left the other side. It looks like a bad haircut, and that's the point.
You think you own the sun? Your hedge does.
A hedge is a wall that thinks it's better than you.
I've read the bylaws, {listener.name}. All nine pages of hedge.

od_fact_cause_bins.t: Your bin was out on a Tuesday, {listener.name}. A Tuesday.
That's my bin. It has a number on it. I painted the number.
Bins go out the night before. Not the night before that. It's not hard.
I've seen what you recycle. We know about you now.
You left the lid up. On purpose. For the foxes.
I've moved it back. You'll move it again. This is my life now.

od_fact_cause_parking.t: That space has been mine since before you were born.
Two spaces! You took two spaces! With one car!
I've put a cone there. It's a legal cone.
Your front tyre was over the line. Don't tell me it wasn't. I have a photograph.
I've parked in front of your drive, and I feel nothing.
You can't own the road, {listener.name}. Except that bit. That bit's mine.

od_fact_cause_noise.t: Do you know what time it was? Do you? It was the second act.
I could hear every note through the wall. Every. Single. Note.
Six in the morning is not a time for a high C.
I've bought earplugs. I can still hear it. I can hear it in my teeth.
I've written to the council, in the key of G.

od_fact_cause_casserole.t: I want my casserole dish back. It's been four years.
That's my dish. It has a chip on the left, and so do you.
You returned it dirty. That's what you did. You returned it dirty.
It was my mother's dish, {listener.name}. She's not dead. She's very angry.
I've seen it on your draining board. I've seen it through the window.
Lids don't just go missing. Lids get taken.

od_fact_cause_ladder.t: I lent you that ladder in good faith.
You said a weekend. Which weekend, {listener.name}? Which weekend?
That's my ladder on your shed. I can see it from my bedroom.
It came back with a dent, and an attitude.
Neither a borrower be. That's all I'm saying. That's all I'm saying this week.
A person who keeps a ladder can't be trusted with anything taller.

od_fact_cause_fire.t: Your stove, {listener.name}. Your stove, in my kitchen. In my lungs.
You could've burned us all in our beds. You nearly burned my bed.
I smell like your dinner, and I'll never forgive it.
Who leaves a pan on? Who does that? You, that's who.
I've got soot on things I didn't know I had.
Insurance doesn't cover what you did to my nerves.

od_fact_cause_stood_up.t: Two coffees, {listener.name}. I drank two coffees.
You could have sent a message. A pigeon. Anything.
I wore the good shirt. You'll never know, because you weren't there.
An hour, I sat there. The waiter knows my whole life now.
I've told everyone. I've told the waiter's mother.
You don't get to wave at me. You lost waving.

od_fact_cause_ex.t: I saw you with that plant. That was our plant.
I'm happy for you. I've been practising saying that.
You said we'd go to the seaside. I've still got the towel.
I've told everybody it was mutual. It was me that was mutual.
I'm over it. I've been over it for hours.

od_fact_cause_promotion.t: Eleven years, I've been there. Eleven. And they gave it to you.
Enjoy the chair, {listener.name}. I hope it's everything you think it is.
Congratulations, by the way. Through my teeth.
What did you do, stand near the boss? Is that all it took?
I trained you. I showed you the good stapler.
You'll need someone to blame in that new job. I'd start with me. I do.

od_fact_cause_row.t: I said what I said, and I'll say it louder.
You started it. No, you did. No, you did.
People heard you, {listener.name}. People in {town.name} heard you.
That's twice you've raised your voice to me, and I raised it first.
I've forgotten what it was about, and I'm still right.
I'd apologise, but then you'd think you'd won.

od_fact_cause_words.t: I know what you said about me. I know who you said it to.
You used a tone. Don't tell me you didn't. There was a tone.
It wasn't what you said. It was your eyebrows.
I've been thinking about it for two weeks, and I've got a reply.
You called me "fine". I heard you. "Fine."
There are some things you can't say in a queue.

od_mood_up.t: I don't want to alarm anyone, but today is going quite well.
I woke up happy and now I am suspicious.
Everything is lovely and I would like it noted.
The sun came out just for me. I checked.
I smiled at a stranger and they did not call anyone.
I feel like a person in an advert for yoghurt.
Today I am the main character.
Somebody held a door for me. I may never recover.
I am in such a good mood that I let someone merge.

od_mood_down.t: I have got a small rain cloud of my own and it follows me about.
It's fine. It's all fine. I said it's fine.
Do you ever just look at a wall for a while?
I had a good cry in the car. Well, the bus.
Today has not been one of the good ones.
I am having a day, and it is having me.
I would like it to be some other time, please.
If anyone wants me, I will be being quiet somewhere.
I tried looking on the bright side, and it was shut.

od_need_tired.t: I am so tired I saluted a lamp post.
I slept for an hour and I remember none of it.
If I sit down I will not get up. I am telling you this now.
My eyes are open but I would not call it a decision.
I have reached the part of tired where everything is funny.
I put the milk in the cupboard and my keys in the tea.
Is it bedtime? It feels like it was bedtime a while ago.
I yawned so wide I heard the news.

od_need_hungry.t: Is it just me or does that bin smell delicious?
I could eat a whole town. Starting with the diner.
My stomach has started making statements.
I would do something quite bad for a sausage roll.
I have been thinking about a sandwich and it is getting personal.
When did we last eat? As a people?
If you need me, I will be looking at food in a window.
I am so hungry I read a menu for pleasure.

od_need_lonely.t: You're the first person I have talked to today. Sorry. Are you busy?
It's been nice talking to you. Is it all right if I go on a bit?
I said good morning to the radio.
I rang the bank just to hear somebody say my name.
The cashier asked how I was, and I told her. All of it.
It gets very quiet round our way.
I have started to recognise the people on the adverts.
Anyway, you must be busy. Are you? Don't go.

od_need_grubby.t: Do I smell of anything? Be kind.
I have been meaning to have a wash since Tuesday.
Somebody stepped away from me on the bus, and that was fair.
I found something in my hair, and I have decided not to look.
The shower and I have been growing apart.
I am at one with the outdoors, mostly on me.
It is not dirt, it is a layer.

od_need_bored.t: I counted the ceiling tiles again. There are still forty.
Something should happen. I am not fussy what.
I have read the back of everything in the house.
If I have to watch one more quiz, I will start winning.
I went to the shop just to see what the shop was doing.
I would pay to see a fire. Sorry. A small one.
Is anything on? Anywhere? For anyone?
I have started having opinions about gravel.

od_need_stiff.t: My back has handed in its notice.
I sat on something at some point, and it was not a chair.
I would like to lie down somewhere soft and be forgotten.
Everything that bends has stopped bending.
There is a knot in my shoulder with its own postcode.
I stood up and three things clicked.
I have not been comfortable since the spring.
I think my spine is a question mark now.

od_rel_stranger.t: Sorry, have we met? You look like someone I owe money.
I don't think we've met. I am, as far as I know, nobody important.
Do you live round here, or are you just visiting the pavement?
Lovely weather for not knowing each other.
You're new. Or I'm new. One of us is new.
I'm going to pretend I know your name, and you can help me.
You have a very familiar coat.
Is this the queue? Are we a queue?
Forgive me, I talk to anyone. It's a condition.
I've seen you at {place.the}, I think. You had a face.

od_rel_known.t: Still at the same place? Good. Good, good.
We keep meeting like this. On the pavement, I mean.
How's the, you know. The thing.
I know exactly who you are, {listener.name}. Mostly from the shoes.
I always mean to stop and chat, and here I am, regretting it. Joke!
Are we the sort of people who hug? No. Good.
I saw you at {place.the} and did a little wave. You didn't see it. That's fine.
You look just the same. I'm not sure what you looked like before.

od_rel_friend.t: Oh good, it's you. I can stop being polite.
I have got so much to tell you, and most of it is about bins.
There she is! Or he. There you are. You know what I mean.
You're the only person who knows about the thing with the trifle.
You look terrible. I say that with love.
I told my mother about you, and she said to stop talking about you.
Pub? I know it's nine in the morning. I'm just saying the word.
If I ever get arrested, you're my phone call. Don't pick up.
We should do something. Not now. We should think about it, though.
Remember the night at {place.the}? We don't speak of it. We just did.

od_rel_housemate.t: Whose turn was it to do the thing? I'll tell you whose.
There's a mug in the sink, and I am not angry, I am just noting it.
Somebody has eaten my yoghurt, and it had my name on it in pen.
You left the landing light on. I'm not your mother. I just live like her.
Could you not breathe so loudly in the mornings?
I've labelled the shelves. You don't need to read it. Just know.
We're out of milk. We have been out of milk, as a household, since I was born.
Did you say something, or was that the boiler?
I love you, but the bathroom is a crime scene.
Who keeps moving the good scissors? I need to know before I die.

od_rel_coworker.t: Is it Friday? Do not tell me if it is not.
I saw the rota. We don't have to talk about the rota.
The boss said a word today. It was "synergy". I had to sit down.
I'd love to help, but I've just remembered I'm on a break.
Same time tomorrow, then. Same everything. Same soup.
If they ask, I was here all morning, and so were you.
My favourite part of the job is leaving it.
Did you get the email? Don't read the email.
Somebody has been microwaving fish, and I intend to find them.
I've worked here eleven years and I still don't know what we do.

od_rel_date.t: You look nice. Have you always looked this nice? I would have said.
I have told everyone about you. Including, I think, a bus driver.
I saved you a chair in my whole entire life. Sorry. That got away from me.
Is it too soon to show you my spreadsheet of holidays?
My mother wants to meet you. I've told her you're shorter than you are.
I keep smiling at nothing. People have started moving seats.
I like how you say "the". The way you do it. "The".
Text me when you get home. It's four doors down, I know. Text me.
You make me want to buy a new towel.
We should get a plant. Start small. See who it likes.

od_rel_spouse.t: Did you remember the thing? No. Neither did I.
You're doing that with your jaw again.
I've been married to you long enough to know that was a sigh.
What do you want for dinner? No, what do you really want. No, not that.
You left the receipt in your coat, and I've read it. Very interesting.
Love you. Have you seen the scissors?
I'd marry you again. I'd want to see the kitchen first.
That's not what happened, and you know it. Tell it properly.
Remember when we used to talk? No, nor me, we're talking now.
Who was that? You had your telephone voice on.

od_rel_foe.t: I've been meaning to not speak to you.
Don't mind me. I'm just standing here disapproving.
I hope you get exactly what you deserve, {listener.name}.
You've got a nerve, turning up on your own pavement.
I'm writing this down. Yes, this. All of this.
I've nothing to say to you. Here it is, in full.
We're all very impressed with how you're holding up, considering what you did.

od_rel_sour.t: I'm sure you meant well. I'm sure that's what it was.
Don't worry about last time. I'm not. I've hardly thought about it. Eleven times.
Fine, thanks. Not that you asked. Which you didn't.
I'd stop and talk, but then I'd have stopped.
Was that a joke? I couldn't tell, it wasn't funny.
Yes, well. We all saw that.
No hard feelings. A few soft ones.
You're looking well, in the circumstances. You know the circumstances.
I'll say nothing. I'll say it very clearly.

od_scene_first_date_open.t: You came! I mean, hello. You came.
Sorry I'm late. I've been outside for twenty minutes, deciding.
You look just like yourself! That's a good thing!
I didn't know if we were hugging, so I've brought this menu.
Is this seat taken? It's mine. I booked it. Sorry. Nerves.

od_scene_first_date_mid.t: So. What do you, you know. Do. With your time. On earth.
Tell me something about yourself that isn't on your face.
I should say now, I have strong opinions on ducks.
I've got three stories and that was one of them.
Do you like soup? That's not a test. It's a test.
My mother says I talk too much when I'm nervous. She's right, she has a list, it's quite long.

od_scene_first_date_close.t: I had a nice time. I think. Did we?
We should do this again, unless you've got a better idea, like moving away.
I'll text you. Do I text you? Who goes first?
That went fine. Nothing's on fire. That's a good sign round here.
Well. Goodbye. I'm going this way. I live the other way, but I'm going this way.
I'd like you to know that I usually have more chin.

od_scene_second_date_open.t: You came back! Nobody comes back!
I wore the other shirt. I only have two. Now you know everything.
I told my mother. I told her a nicer version of you.
I've been looking forward to this since about four minutes after the last one.
I brought a question. I've written it down. Is that weird?
This time I've eaten first, so I can concentrate.

od_scene_second_date_mid.t: You did that thing again, with your eyebrow.
What's your worst habit? I'll go first. How long have you got?
I think I like you. I wanted to say it before I ate.
I've told you about the ducks. Nobody gets the ducks at a second date.
What are we doing about Sundays? Long term. I'm just asking.
Do you want the last chip? I'm asking because I've decided you're important.

od_scene_second_date_close.t: So we're doing this, are we? This?
I'm going to tell people. Is that all right? I've already told people.
You're my favourite person at this table.
Same time next week? And all the other weeks? I'm joking. I'm not.
I'm not going to say anything soppy. I've got it written down for later.
I'd walk you home, but I think I'm walking on the road.

od_scene_proposal_open.t: Can I talk to you about something? It isn't the bins.
Sit down. No, stand up. Sit. I've thought about this.
Remember when you said you liked this bench? I've had it rated.
I've got something in my pocket. It's not a sandwich. Don't get excited. Get excited.
You look nice. Why are you looking nice today? It makes this harder.
Is it me, or is it hot? Don't answer. I need you to listen.

od_scene_proposal_ask.t: Will you marry me? I've got a whole speech but I've eaten it.
I'd like to be annoyed by you for the rest of my life. Officially.
I've looked at everyone in this town, and you're my favourite. Marry me.
So I was wondering if you'd want to share a toaster. For ever. With a ring.
Marry me. I'll give you the left side of the bed and all of the blanket.
I got down on one knee, and I may need help, but first: will you?

od_scene_proposal_answer.t: Are you asking me or are you stuck? Yes. Both. Yes.
I've been waiting for you to work that out for weeks.
Oh, you ridiculous person. Get up. Well, in a minute. Ask me again.
Is that a real ring? Don't tell me. Let me enjoy it.
I need to sit down. I am sitting down. I need to sit down more.
I'll tell you what I'd say if you got up off the ground.

od_scene_wedding_open.t: You look like the best decision I've ever made.
I'm not crying, it's the flowers. I'm allergic to being this happy.
Everyone's here. Even your aunt. Especially your aunt.
Did you see the goblin's got the rings? Check the rings.
Your hands are shaking. So are mine. That'll be the whole building, then.
This is either the best day of my life, or a very expensive lunch.

od_scene_wedding_vow.t: I promise to tell you when you've got something in your teeth.
I promise to love you, and to pretend to like your mother's soup.
I'll always listen. Mostly. I'll nod in the right places.
I promise to wake you up for fires, and to let you sleep through the rest.
I take you, with the snoring and the opinions about gravel.
For better, for worse, for all the bills, every three days.

od_scene_wedding_close.t: Well, that's that. You can't get rid of me now. I've read the paperwork.
We did it! Nobody objected! I checked the back row!
Is it cake now? I was promised cake.
Mine. Sorry. I just wanted to say it out loud.
I've never loved anyone so much in such uncomfortable shoes.
Let's go home. Whose home? We should have sorted that out.

od_scene_row_open.t: There you are. I've been wanting a word. Several, in fact.
Oh, here we go. Everyone, this is the one I told you about.
You've got a nerve, showing your face at {place.the}.
Don't you walk away from me. I'm walking towards you. Stop.
I'm so glad I've run into you. I've written this down.
Excuse me! Excuse me! Yes, you! I'm excusing you!

od_scene_row_mid.t: Don't you dare bring my mother into this. She'll only agree with you.
I've got witnesses! That man saw it! Sir, did you see it?
You're not even listening! I can tell by your ears!
That is the single most ridiculous thing that's been said in this building.
Oh, I'm sorry, was my opinion too close to your opinion?
Say that again, slower, so everyone can enjoy it.

od_scene_row_close.t: This isn't over. It's just, I've got to get to the shops.
I'll see you in court. Or at the bins. Whichever's first.
Good day! I said good day! Good evening, if it gets that far!
You'll hear from me. You'll hear it through the wall.
Fine! Fine. It's fine! I'm leaving now, on purpose!
And another thing! No, it's gone. It'll come back to me. It'll come back to you.

od_scene_showdown_open.t: Thank you for hearing me, and for the chairs.
I've brought photographs, a tape measure and a sworn statement from a pigeon.
I'd like it on the record that I was here first.
The town clerk can see what kind of person I'm dealing with.
I've prepared a folder. It has tabs. This is what you've brought me to.
I've taken a morning off work for this, and I intend to enjoy it.

od_scene_showdown_mid.t: If you look at exhibit four, that's the moment it all went wrong.
I object! Can I object? Is that what we do here?
I've lived on that street for nineteen years, and I've never once been so insulted by a shrub.
That's not what happened. That's what happened in your head.
On the night in question, I was at home, listening to the whole thing.
The facts are simple, and there are forty-one of them.

od_scene_showdown_close.t: Fine. If that's what the town hall says. I'll be appealing to the town.
So that's it, is it? After all that? I want my folder back.
I accept the ruling, and I'll never speak of it again, except daily.
I hope you're happy. You look happy. It's not a good look.
Well. I suppose that's that. Is there a cafe round here?
Next time, I'm bringing a lawyer. Or a bigger pigeon.

od_scene_thanks_open.t: Sit down, it's on me. Everything's on me. For a year.
I don't know how you say thank you for this, so I got you a muffin.
Here's the person who carried me out of a fire, everyone. Everyone? No? Just me then.
I've been wanting to find you. I had a speech, and it was mostly crying.
I hear you've got a bad shoulder. That'd be me.
You're looking well. Last time I saw you, I was upside down.

od_scene_thanks_mid.t: You didn't have to do that. I mean, it was your job. But you didn't have to.
If you ever need anything: a kidney, a lift, a casserole.
They told me you went back in. Why would anyone do that?
I'd have left me in there, if I'd seen the state of my kitchen.
It was nothing. It wasn't nothing. It was very heavy.
I keep thinking about it. Then I think about what I was wearing.

od_scene_housewarming_open.t: Come in, come in! Mind the wet paint, it's holding the wall up.
Welcome back to the house! It's the same one, only less on fire.
You can still smell it a bit, if you lean on the door.
We've got new boards! Smell the boards! Go on!
Shoes off! We've only just got a floor.
I've made a cake. I've kept an eye on it the entire time.

od_scene_housewarming_mid.t: It looks better than it did, if I'm honest. Sorry. It does.
I've missed this kitchen. I've missed it not being a crime scene.
Who's for tea? I've got the kettle back. We've made peace.
Thank you all for coming, and for the pie. There were eleven pies.
I've put a smoke alarm in every room. Including the cupboard.
You'd never know. You'd know a bit. Don't go upstairs.

od_scene_introduce_open.t: Hello. I'm told I have to meet you.
Somebody said we'd get on. I don't know why people say these things.
Hi! Everyone keeps saying we should meet! So this is that!
I've heard a lot about you. None of it was checked.
Don't get up. I'll be over here, being introduced.

od_scene_introduce_mid.t: What do you do when you're not being pushed at strangers?
I can tell we're going to be polite to each other for years.
Well, this is nice. Is it? I think it's nice.
Do you know anything about gutters? No? Well, we tried.
You have a very firm handshake. I'd like my hand back.
We've got nothing in common, and I find that very restful.

od_scene_date_open.t: They said you were single. They said it quite loudly.
Somebody's set us up. I'd like to know who, and whether they're watching.
I don't usually do this. I've done this four times.
I'm told I should "be myself". I've brought someone else in case.
Are you here for the date, or the free bread?
You don't look like the description. It said "tall-ish".

od_scene_date_mid.t: So what's wrong with you? I'm joking. I've got a list.
I've got to be up early, in case this goes badly.
If this works, we tell people we met at a library.
What's your stance on sharing a dessert? It's a serious question.
You've got nice hands. I don't know why I said that.
Should we be enjoying this? I've lost track.

od_scene_rowstir_open.t: I never liked you. I've only just realised, but I never did.
Something about your face has been bothering me since Tuesday.
Who do you think you are? Be specific.
I saw what you did. I don't know what it was, but I saw it.
Don't look at me in that tone of voice.
What did you say? You didn't say anything? Exactly.

od_scene_rowstir_mid.t: You're everything that's wrong with this street, and it's a long street.
I'll have you know I've been in a bad mood for years, and I earned it.
My whole family's going to hear about this. I'll start with the quiet ones.
You call that an argument? I've had better rows with a door.
Go on, say it! Say it! No, not that, that's horrible!
And your shoes, while we're at it!

od_scene_patch_open.t: Look. I've been thinking. Don't get excited.
I brought you a casserole. I don't know what's in it. Peace, mainly.
Can we not do this any more? I'm tired, and my folder's full.
I'm not saying I was wrong. I'm saying I've stopped enjoying it.
I saw you at the shop and I hid behind the bread. This has to stop.
This is hard for me to say, so I'll say it fast, and to your shoulder.

od_scene_patch_mid.t: I suppose we both said some things. You said more. But we both said some.
What was it about, even? No, don't. Don't. It'll start again.
You're all right. Don't tell anyone I said so.
I'm sorry about the gnome. I'm not sorry about the other gnome.
Shall we say no more about it? I've got a lot more about it, but shall we?
I've missed having someone to wave at, even if it was in a rude way.

od_sit_cafe.t: They've started writing my name on the cup wrong on purpose.
Is it just me, or has this coffee got an aftertaste of Monday?
That's four coins for a drink that's mostly air.
I come here to work. I've been working on this muffin since nine.
Somebody's laptop has been here longer than the staff.
I asked for it small. It came in a bucket.
I can tell how a day's going by the foam.
They've got oat, soy, almond and something called "regret".

od_sit_pub.t: Same again? Is it ever not the same again?
The quiz is on Thursday. I'm not saying I've been revising.
That stool's been mine since the flood.
I only came in for the one. That was on Friday.
Somebody's put a song on. I'd like to speak to them outside. Kindly.
The crisps are the healthiest thing in here, and that includes us.
We're not drunk. We're relaxed about the floor.
They've changed the beer. It's got a name now, and opinions.

od_sit_gym.t: What's the point of a mirror that's this honest?
I've been on this bike for an hour and I'm still here.
Is that sweat, or am I just sad from the top down?
I only come for the shower, and the sense of having been.
Somebody's grunting like they're being paid to.
I've paid for this year. I've come twice. That's the best two visits money can buy.
I lifted a thing and put it back. I feel like the universe.
Do I look bigger? Be honest. Lie.

od_sit_park.t: It's nice here, if you don't look at the ducks.
Someone's dog just looked at me like it knew.
This is my favourite tree. Don't tell the others.
I come here to think, and then I look at a squirrel instead.
Nothing here wants anything from me. Except that goose.
They've mown it again. It had only just got comfortable.
I sat on the wet bit. I'm staying till it's dry.
Every park has one man with a very small kite.

od_sit_shop.t: I came in for milk, and I'm leaving with a lamp.
Is this cheaper, or is it just a bigger sign?
They've moved everything, and it's so they can see us suffer.
I don't need it. I'm just holding it for a while.
Have you seen what they want for a cucumber?
I've been looking at this shelf so long I've started to work here.
Unexpected item in the bagging area. Story of my life.
Everything is on offer, except what I came for.

od_sit_diner.t: What's the soup? Don't tell me. I like the surprise.
I've had the same order for nine years. It has my name on it, sort of.
Is that gravy, or is it holding the table up?
You get a free refill and a free opinion from the cook.
It's all fried, even the salad. Especially the salad.
It's not a good menu, but it's a long one.
She calls everyone "love" here. She hasn't learned a name since 1990.
I asked for it well done, and they called the fire brigade. Joke. Sorry. Too soon?

od_sit_clinic.t: I've been in this waiting room long enough to get promoted.
The magazines are from before the bridge.
They told me to take a seat. I've been taking it for two hours.
It's probably nothing. I've looked it up. It's definitely something.
The nurse said "hmm". I don't like a "hmm".
What's the worst it could be? Don't answer that, I've got a leaflet.
Everyone in here is coughing at each other like it's a conversation.
They asked me to rate my pain out of ten. I said it's more of a feeling about the car park.

od_sit_work.t: Is it me, or is it still only ten o'clock?
Look busy, someone's coming. Oh. It's only you.
Remind me what we do here. Broadly.
We've run out of the good pens, and morale.
I've been told I'm a valued member of the team, so I'm looking for another job.
Only four hours till the end of the day. Or six. It's hard to look.
This could've been an email. So could I.
I'm on my break. I've been on it, spiritually, since March.

od_sit_morning.t: Don't talk to me. Talk near me. Very quietly.
I've had one coffee, so I'm technically a person.
Who invented seven o'clock, and were they punished?
Something's wrong with the morning. It's all over the place.
I put my shoes on the wrong feet and just thought, fine.
The birds are at it already. What have they got to be so pleased about?
I've been awake for an hour and nothing has been explained.
Today's the day. I don't know for what.

od_sit_night.t: What are you doing up? I mean, what am I?
It's very quiet. I don't trust it.
I can see every light in the street. I've named some of them.
You think different things at this hour. Mostly about the boiler.
Is that a fox, or a neighbour?
I should go to bed. I've been saying that since Tuesday.
It's one of those nights where you can hear the fridge thinking.
There's a light on at the town hall, and I would like to know why.

od_sit_home.t: There's a noise, and I've decided it's the pipes.
I'm going to sit down for one minute. Tell my family I loved them.
Who lives like this? We do. I know. We do.
I'd tidy up, but then I'd know where things were.
The house is either too hot or too cold, and it's always somebody's fault.
Someone's left a light on in a room nobody's been in since Easter.
Home is where you know which stair creaks. We have no stairs, I know. It's a saying.
I've been looking for the remote, and I've found a whole other remote.

od_spell_tidy_cast.t: Right, everything back in its place. Quickly, before I lose my nerve.
A little Tidy. Nothing fancy. Just the floor, and possibly my life.
Come on, socks. You know where you live.
Up you get, the lot of you. Shelves. Now.

od_spell_tidy_ok.t: Look at that. You could eat off it. Don't.
All done, and I never touched a duster.
It's beautiful. I feel like a different person with a smaller pile.
There. Now nobody touch anything for ever.

od_spell_tidy_bad.t: It's tidied everything. Everything. Where's the cutlery? Where's the cat?
It's filed the cushions by size. I can't find my keys or the door.
It has alphabetised the fridge. I don't want to talk about it.
Well, it's very clean. I've just lost most of my belongings.

od_spell_warm_cast.t: Here, a little bit of warm. Don't tell the gas company.
Bit of a chill. Leave it with me.
I do this to the bed sometimes. It's the same thing. It's fine.

od_spell_warm_ok.t: There. Like standing next to a good radiator.
That's better, isn't it? Your ears have gone a nice colour.
Toasty. I'm good at this. I should charge.
Oh, that's lovely. I've done my own socks as well.

od_spell_warm_bad.t: Why is the curtain smoking? Is it meant to be smoking?
That's too warm. That's definitely too warm. That's not a colour.
I've cooked the armchair a bit.
Don't panic, but your hat has started to steam.

od_spell_mend_cast.t: Come on, you. Back the way you were.
Right, you lovely burnt thing, let's have a look.
A little Mend. Not the whole wall. Just where it hurts.
Hold on. Wood remembers. You have to ask it nicely.

od_spell_mend_ok.t: Good as new. Better. It's got a bit of a shine.
There, that's one less for the crew.
That took some doing. The wall's stopped sulking.
Look, you can't even see where it went wrong.

od_spell_mend_bad.t: It's mended itself to the door. The door was not involved before.
Well, that's worse. How is that worse?
Ah. I've mended the burn. It's a very solid burn now.
We're going to need more boards. And an apology.

od_spell_hush_cast.t: I'm so sorry, but you're being very loud. Shh.
Just a moment of peace, if I may.
Let's all have a nice bit of quiet.
Sorry, I can't hear myself think. It's a short spell.

od_spell_hush_ok.t: Oh, that's better. You can hear the birds.
There. Now we can all pretend nothing was said.
Lovely. It wears off in an hour. Use it wisely.
You've got a very nice face when you're not using it.

od_spell_hush_bad.t: Why are you louder? How are you louder?
Oh no. It's turned you up.
I can hear you in my fillings now.
That's the whole street's windows rattling. That was you.

od_law_stop.t: Evening. Do you know why I've pulled you over?
Afternoon. A word, if you've got a minute.
Hello there. Mind stepping this way for a moment?
Just a quick chat. Nothing to worry about yet.
Could I have a look at your licence, please?
You were in a bit of a hurry back there. Everything all right?
Hold on there, if you would. Won't take long.
Sorry to bother you. Routine. Mostly.
Good day. Is this yours? Only it's doing something it shouldn't.
Pop over here for me, would you?

od_law_excuse.t: I was only going a little bit fast. A normal amount of fast.
It wasn't me. It was someone who looks a lot like me.
I was just holding it for a friend. A tall friend. He's gone.
My cat does the driving on Tuesdays, so really it's her you want.
I was late. Is being late not a kind of emergency?
The sign was very small. I think the town should do something about the sign.
I thought it was allowed. Everybody does it. Everybody!
I've never done anything like this in my life. Well. Not today.
It was a spell. A very small one. It practically did itself.
I'm a lovely person, ask anyone. Not that one. The other one.

od_law_ticket.t: Name and address, please. And yes, I can spell it for you.
That's a ticket, I'm afraid. Pay it at the town office, and have a nice day.
I'll just write this down. Don't look at the pen like that.
Here you are. It's not a gift, but it is wrapped nicely.
You'll want to read the back. Nobody does, but you'll want to.
Sign here. That's not a confession, only a receipt.
It's a small fine, in the grand scheme. Smaller than my sandwich budget.
Keep this somewhere safe. The pocket you lose things in is not safe.
Fourteen days to pay. Fourteen. I counted on my fingers.
Nothing personal. The book says what the book says.

od_law_warn.t: Go on, then. But I'll remember your face.
Just this once. And I'm only saying that because it's cold.
Consider yourself told. Properly told. With the voice.
I'm letting you off with a warning. Don't make me regret the warning.
Off you go. Next time I'll find my pen.
I'll pretend I didn't see that. I'm good at pretending. Ask my mother.
Fair enough. A word to the wise, then, and a smile to the wise.
Right. Be sensible. I'm too tired for paperwork.
Not today. Go on, before I change my mind.
It's a warning. A warning is like a ticket but kinder.

od_law_arrest.t: I'm afraid I'll have to ask you to come with me.
Hands where I can see them, please. Gently. There's no rush.
You're under arrest. I'd say it's nothing personal, but it is, a bit.
Right, that's quite enough. Down to the station we go.
Come along, there's a good soul. I've got a kettle at the station.
I'm taking you in. Mind the step, it's a terrible step.
That's the end of it, I'm afraid. Turn around for me.
You have the right to a cup of tea and a very long think.
I did ask nicely. Twice. Let's go.
Mind your head in the car. I'd hate to add to your troubles.

od_law_run.t: I've left the oven on! Goodbye!
Oh no, oh no, oh no, oh no.
Somebody stop that hedge! I need it!
I'm quite fast when I want to be!
Don't look at me! Look at that cloud!
Run, legs, run! You were built for this!
I'm not running. I'm walking very, very quickly!

od_law_caught.t: Fine. Fine! I'm done. I'm very out of breath.
I should have done more stairs. Please write that down.
Alright, alright. You've got me. Can I sit?
That was a lot of running for one little thing.
I give up. My knees gave up a street ago.
I'd like a lawyer and a glass of water. In that order. No, the other order.
It seemed like a good idea at the time. It always does.
Don't be cross. I can't breathe and be told off at once.
I only ran because you were chasing. That's how it started.
Oh, my side. Oh, my other side.

od_law_pet_found.t: Somebody here is missing a very cross little face. Anyone?
Found this one wandering near the shops. No collar, plenty of opinions.
Has anyone lost a pet? Only this one's been very polite about it, which is suspicious.
I've got a lost one here. It's eaten my biscuit. It stays until someone claims it.
Is this yours? It keeps looking at the door like it's late for something.
Right, who's missing a friend? Hands up. Nicely.
Little scamp was under a bench. We had a long talk. I did most of it.
Found one wandering about. Looks fed, looks loved, looks unrepentant.
Anyone know whose this is? It has, I should say, a lot of fur on my uniform now.
It followed me for three streets. I'm not complaining. I'm only saying.

od_law_pet_thanks.t: Oh, you found them! Oh, bless you! I've been out of my mind!
Thank you, thank you. I'd have gone on looking until Christmas.
There you are, you terror! Where have you been? Don't answer that.
You're a marvel. I'll bring you a cake. Or a pie. Or both.
I'd given up, honestly. I'd started on the posters.
Oh, my little rascal. Never do that to me again. You will, but never.
I can't thank you enough. I can try, though, for quite a while.
You've no idea what this means. Well, you might. You've got a kind face.
They were only gone since breakfast and I've aged ten years.
Right, home. Both of us. Straight home. No detours.

od_law_calm.t: Nothing to see here, folks. Well, a bit. But not much.
Step back, please. Give them some room. They're only a fire engine, not a show.
Let's all take a breath. In through the nose, out through the gossip.
Everything's under control. I say that a lot, and it's mostly true.
Back a bit, please. Nobody needs to see that close.
Nobody's in danger. That's the best news you'll get today, so enjoy it.
Easy now. If we all shout at once, nobody hears anything.
Please keep walking. The excitement is on its way home.
Stay calm. If you can't be calm, be quiet. If you can't be quiet, be elsewhere.
It's all in hand, I promise. If it isn't, you'll be the second to know.

od_law_cordon.t: Sorry, can't go through. The crew need the space.
Keep behind the tape, please. It's not decoration.
That way's closed until further notice. And by further I mean quite a bit.
I know it's your shortcut. It's everyone's shortcut. Today it's a no.
Not through here, madam. Not through here, sir. Not through here, dog.
Back a bit, please. A bit more. That's it. You're a treasure.
It's a cordon, not a suggestion.
Round the other side, please. The scenic route is lovely this time of year.
We'll let you know when it's safe. You'll hear it from me first, and then from everyone.
The only place you're going is back. Gently, but back.

od_law_fender.t: You reversed straight into me! Straight! Like a drunk crab!
It's a scratch. It was already there. Probably.
I was indicating! I was indicating with my heart!
You can't just stop in the middle of the road. It's a road! It's literally for going!
Well, your bumper was in the way. Your bumper was extremely in the way.
Nobody's hurt, so can we all stop shouting? I'm getting a headache.
I'll give you my details if you give me yours and stop pointing.
That's my mother's car. She's going to ask. She always asks.
It's a small dent. A very small dent. A dent you could put a mouse in.
We'll swap names and say no more. Or we'll say plenty more, but quietly.

od_law_noise.t: It's gone half past ten and they're still singing. Singing!
Every Saturday, the same. A drill. Who drills for fun?
I don't mind a bit of music. I mind that particular bit, three times.
That dog has opinions about the moon, and so does the owner.
It sounds like somebody's moving a piano. Through the roof.
Their party's got a bass you can feel in your teeth.
I've knocked twice. They knocked back. In rhythm.
I'm not one to complain. I'm having a very good go, though.
I can hear them through the wall. I can hear what they're having for dinner.
It's quiet, then it's loud. It's the quiet I mind. It's planning.

od_law_witness.t: Somebody just walked out with a bag of crisps and a very guilty face.
I turned my back for a second. One second! And the till's an inch lighter.
They were here, they were looking at the mugs, then they were not here and neither was a mug.
I saw the whole thing. I was holding a mop at the time, which I mention for context.
They took it and left, like it was theirs. Very confident. I admired it, honestly.
I called out and they just waved. Waved! Like they were leaving a party.
It was a very small thing, but it was my small thing.
That's the third time this month. I'm thinking of getting a bell.
They put it up their coat. A whole loaf, up a coat. Impressive, in its way.
I'd like to say I stopped them. I'd like a lot of things.

od_radio_take.t: Received. On my way. Hold the tea.
Copy that. Two minutes, maybe three, depending on the roundabout.
Understood. Tell them to stay put and not to touch anything.
Right, I'll go and have a look. Don't wait up.
That's us. We're rolling. Mind the cat.
Heard you. I'll be there before the kettle boils. Mine, not theirs.
Roger. Is it the same one as last week, or a fresh one?
Okay, noted. I'll take it from here.
On it. Tell my sandwich I'll be back.
Message received. Don't say anything I'd regret in a report.

od_rift_signs.t: The milk's gone off, and I only bought it this morning.
Has the sky always looked a bit wrong in that corner?
There's a hum. You hear it? Under the traffic. Like a fridge, but cross.
All the dogs are facing the same way. I don't like it.
My watch is running slow. Or the afternoon is.
The streetlamps are flickering in order. In ORDER.
The air tastes of pennies. Is that normal?
The pigeons have all gone. Every one. Even the rude one.
Something's off with the light round here. Everything's a bit too sharp.
The tea tastes of thunder, and I haven't even added anything.

od_rift_gawk.t: Well, would you look at that.
It's rather pretty, isn't it? Don't tell anyone I said so.
Is it supposed to move like that? It looks like it's breathing.
My phone says there's no signal. Funny. I'm only looking.
I've never seen the sky go that colour. Or do that, with its edges.
Somebody should do something. I'll just watch while they do.
I'm not afraid. I'm standing very still, which is different.
Look at it just sit there, like it owns the place.
That's no cloud. I know a cloud. That's a hole in the afternoon.
Stay out of it, mind. Don't touch. Do not poke it with the umbrella.

od_rift_panic.t: Everyone inside! Inside! Shut the door!
Not again! We only just fixed the awning!
Mind the pram! Mind the pram!
Get indoors! Take the cat! Leave the cake!
Oh no, oh no, oh dear, oh my, oh no.
Close the shutters! The big ones! The ones we never use!
I'm going home. Don't look for me. I'll be under the bed.
Move, move, move, I've left my kettle on in my mind!
Lock the door and keep the lights low. Then the biscuits.
Stay away from the sky! That's all I've got!

od_rift_hunter.t: Right, stand back. This is our department.
Hunters, coming through. Mind the gear, it bites.
Everyone clear of the edge, please. We'll take it from here.
Nobody panic. We've done this before, and mostly it worked.
Form up. You take left, I'll take the noisy bit.
Good. It's small. I've seen worse on a Friday.
Keep the crowd back. If it's got teeth, I'll let you know.
All right, team. Be brave and be tidy.
We'll have this closed by teatime. Possibly late tea.
Stay behind me. No, further behind. Further. Ah, fine.

od_rift_sealed.t: That's it, sealed. You can all breathe now.
All quiet again. Funny how much I miss the hum.
The sky looks normal. I'm trusting it about as far as I can throw it.
They closed it! The hunters closed it! Someone clap.
Right, it's done. Back to your lives. And your cups of tea.
There's a scorch on the pavement. I'd put a plant pot on it.
Quiet, finally. I could sleep for a week.
It's gone. The milk's still off, but it's gone.
And that's one more for the book. Mind the paperwork.
Nobody tell the council. They'll want a form.

od_fight_skill.t: Brace yourselves, it's the good one!
A little something I've been saving!
This is going to look much cooler than it feels!
I practised this in the bathroom!
Stand back, I'm doing the thing!

od_fight_down.t: I'm fine. I'm just going to lie here a bit.
Someone tell my tea I'll be late.
Oh, that's not good. That's not good at all.
Ooh, stars. Lots of little stars.
I'll just rest my eyes. For a good while.
Tell them I was brilliant. Tell them I was brilliant and horizontal.
Down, but not out. Down, mostly.
Not dead! Just resting! Very, very firmly resting!

od_fight_win.t: That's the lot! We did it!
Got it! Somebody write that down!
Ha! Not so clever now, are you?
Done. And nobody's even bleeding. Much.
Another one for the pub quiz.
We won! I wasn't sure. I'm still not sure.
Clear! The coast is clear, the sky is clear, I'm hungry.
That's it. Tidy up and go home.

od_fight_swap.t: I've got this one. Step back.
My turn. Go and have a sit.
I'll cover you. Go on, get your breath.
Don't worry, I'm up. Go and recover.
Right, I'll take the front. You take the biscuits.
Behind me, please. All of you. I mean it.
Stepping up! Somebody hold my coat!
Let the rested one have a go.

od_fight_hurt.t: Ouch! That was my good arm!
That one stung. I may complain later.
Right, that's rude. That's just rude.
Ow! I only just got dressed!
I felt that in my teeth.
Not the face! Anything but the face!
Argh, my knee! The other knee!

od_fact_arrested.t: I spent the night in the cells, {fact.ago}. The tea was surprisingly good.
They let me go, {fact.ago}, with a stern talking-to and a biscuit.
{fact.ago} I was arrested. Don't ask. It was a misunderstanding with a very small crime.
I've been in the cells, {fact.ago}. The bunk was lumpy and the company was me.
Spent a night with the law, {fact.ago}. They don't do breakfast.
The officer was polite about it, {fact.ago}. That made it worse, somehow.
I was brought in, {fact.ago}, over the {fact.cause}. I'm still cross.
The cells are smaller than they look, {fact.ago}. I'd know.

od_fact_ticketed.t: I got a ticket, {fact.ago}. I'm using it as a bookmark.
The officer wrote me up {fact.ago}. Lovely handwriting. Awful news.
Fined, {fact.ago}. I'm still arguing it in the bath.
I had a ticket {fact.ago}. Don't tell my mother, she'll tell the street.
They fined me, {fact.ago}, for something I'd call a small oversight.
{fact.ago} I was ticketed. It was {fact.cause}, they said. I say it was Tuesday.
I got a ticket, {fact.ago}. The pen was the nicest thing about it.
I paid up, {fact.ago}, and I'm still sore about it.

od_fact_rift_near.t: Did you see it? A rift opened at {fact.place} {fact.ago}. The milk's off to this day.
There was a rift at {fact.place}, {fact.ago}. I could hear the hum in my fillings.
A rift opened near {fact.place} {fact.ago}. My cat has not been the same.
{fact.ago}, over at {fact.place}. That sky was never meant to look like that.
You hear about the rift at {fact.place}? {fact.ago}. I stayed in, and so should you.
The rift at {fact.place} gave me a turn, {fact.ago}. I'm better now. Mostly.
{fact.place} had a rift {fact.ago}. Property prices are a mystery to me now.
I saw the sky go wrong over {fact.place} {fact.ago}. I still check it twice a day.

od_fact_hunter.t: I fought at the rift, {fact.ago}. My arms haven't forgiven me.
{fact.ago} I was out at the rift with the hunters. I'd do it again. In a bigger hat.
I stood with the hunters at the rift, {fact.ago}. Nobody asked, I just went.
I helped close that rift {fact.ago}. It's on my arm. The scar, not the rift.
I went out to the rift {fact.ago}. I came back with a story and a limp.
I'm not a hunter, but I held the line at the rift {fact.ago}.
The rift, {fact.ago}. I was there. I'd tell you more but my ears are still ringing.
I swung a stick at a rift {fact.ago}. It worked, apparently.

od_fact_knocked.t: I got knocked flat at the rift, {fact.ago}. Lovely view of the ceiling afterwards.
{fact.ago} a rift put me on the floor. I woke up to a medic and a sandwich.
I went down hard at the rift {fact.ago}. I'm told I said something poetic.
Knocked down at the rift, {fact.ago}. I'm fine. I only walk with one hand on the wall.
I was out cold at the rift {fact.ago}. The first thing I saw was a hunter's boots.
I took a thump at the rift {fact.ago}. I still hear the bell.
A rift put me down {fact.ago}. Don't make a fuss. Actually, make a small fuss.
Flat on my back at the rift, {fact.ago}. It gives you perspective.

od_fact_pet_back.t: Got the little one back, {fact.ago}. The officer carried them home. I cried a bit.
They found my pet {fact.ago}. Under a bench, the villain.
{fact.ago} my pet came home with a policeman. Best surprise of my year.
My pet went missing {fact.ago}, and turned up with a very proud officer.
I've got my pet back, {fact.ago}. Don't ever tell them how worried I was.
Lost, then found, {fact.ago}. I'd like it to stay found.
The officer brought my pet back {fact.ago}. I owe that person a pie.
My pet is home again, {fact.ago}. I counted the whiskers. All there.

od_fact_lifted_near.t: Did you hear? {fact.person} got caught, {fact.ago}. Lifting something from a shop, they say.
{fact.who} told me about it {fact.ago}. Someone I know was caught with a loaf up their coat.
{fact.a} got nabbed {fact.ago}. I'm only saying it because it's true.
Somebody I know was picked up {fact.ago}. I won't say who. It was {fact.person}.
I heard {fact.person} got caught {fact.ago}. Not that I'd gossip.
{fact.ago} a friend of mine was caught lifting. I'm sworn to silence and also to tell you.
It was in the shop on the corner, {fact.ago}. {fact.person}, would you believe.
{fact.person} was caught, {fact.ago}. A shame. They had such nice manners.
